Degree Programs
Degree Programs
Traditional CS MS/PhD
The traditional CS MS/PhD program offers students the opportunity to study with award-winning faculty in a wide range of research specialty areas at a truly world-class institution.
Program Information
​​
Admissions
​​
Professional CS MS (PMP)
The PMP is designed for professionals who want to pursue an MS degree for more specific CS education, to obtain cutting-edge knowledge in the fast-moving field of IT, apply what they’ve learned in their jobs, and who seek career advancement.
Program Information
​​
Admissions
​​
MS Data Engineering (MSDE)
The MSDE focuses on the principles and practices of managing data at scale.
Program Information
​​
Admissions
​​
MS Data Science (MDS)
The MDS provides students with abilities in computational and statistical thinking and skills, which may be combined with domain knowledge to address data-rich problems from diverse fields and various industries.
Program Information
​​
Admissions
​​
CS PhD Minor
Graduate students in other PhD programs at UW–Madison who plan to minor in CS should click the link for more information.
More Information
​​
Certificate Programs
Professional Capstone Certificate (PCP)
If you have obtained a bachelor’s degree in a field other than CS but now want to learn the fundamentals of CS so you can apply for software developer jobs, the Professional Capstone Certificate Program is for you.
More Information
​​
Capstone Certificate in Computer Sciences Online Kickstart Program for Professionals
Kickstart is is designed for students who did not earn an undergraduate degree in computer science and now want to learn the fundamentals of computer science, including the basics of artificial intelligence (AI), through online courses.
